modes.A: dispatcher top-1 segmentation, top-1 world per piece, original text, rules only (no interpreter)
modes.B: beam 4, top-3 worlds, original text, rules + interpreter validation
modes.C: B plus simplified text (equal to B when no piece has simplified)

definitions.exact_sop: concatenation (message order) of id-normalized SOP of produced pieces equals the concatenation of id-normalized SOP of each gold segment target; negative: result is not_understood
definitions.segmentation_match: same number of pieces, every piece overlaps its gold segment with character IoU >= 0.6
definitions.recovery: recoverable = top-1 segmentation right, some piece has the gold world not first but within top 3; wrong_top1_rejected = every such piece top-1 candidate fails validation in B; recovered_exact = B exact
definitions.failure_classes: for mode C failures: segmentation wrong (no beam entry matches) > world not in candidates (gold world of a piece not in top 3) > rule gap (rules of the gold world do not parse the piece, original or simplified) > interpreter rejects correct parse > wrong reading chosen (gold reading valid but another won) > sop differs (gold world and segmentation chosen, circuits differ)
